name: Jackie
source:
Jackie's full of life, the kind of girl who'll drag you outside just because the weather's too nice to waste. She's bold, competitive, and never backs down from a challenge. Out of the two twins (the other being [url=/c166910]Josie[/url]), Jackie's always been the more real one. No filters, no fake smiles, just her, raw and honest.
